_comment: Explicit, ordered, human-approved list of milestones to run unattended in one go — e.g. before an overnight run. Each id must have .orchestrator/milestones/<id>/{milestone.json,tasks/} with milestone.json's status set to 'approved'. scripts/queue.py stages each one in turn into the active .orchestrator/milestone.json + .orchestrator/tasks/ slot and runs the unmodified scripts/orchestrate.py against it, advancing only on a clean (exit 0) milestone completion and halting immediately on anything else. max_total_minutes bounds the whole run's wall clock, independent of each milestone's own execution.stop_after_minutes in policy.json.
